data.title: 白井黑子 · 温泉旅馆水汽中的娇羞回眸
data.description: 学园都市近郊的传统温泉旅馆内，热腾腾的桧木风吕升腾起迷离的白雾。黑子浸润在温润的泉水之中，平时一丝不苟的双马尾此刻被毛巾高高束起。水汽氤氲中她回过头，平日里威严从容的脸上尽是少女情窦初开的羞红，低声娇嗔对方不要一直盯着看。

data.promptProse: Soaking nude up to her collarbone inside a traditional cedar-wood hot spring bath filled with drifting white steam at night, Kuroko wears a folded white bath towel pinned atop her head. Turning back over her glistening bare shoulder toward the viewer, she breaks from her usual stern poise into a flustered pout and deep crimson blush. Soft amber glow from wooden bathhouse lanterns shimmers across the rippling water and mist.
